title: No interviews...what's next? ✍️
description:
If you’re not getting interviews from all the applications you’ve been submitting, there are an endless number of reasons, but what YOU can do is take a look at your resume. You want to honestly ask yourself if you work experience is showing your qualifications. Look at each resume bullet and ask “Why does this matter?” If it’s just a responsibility it doesn’t really. If it’s an achievement that shows impact THAT is what matters. #resume #resumetips #resumebuilder #resumebullets
